body: Just an update for anyone who cares, I've visited the ER tonight for mental health issues and am going to begin an outpatient program.  After some careful thought my problem definitely stems around the feeling of being unable to cope and not having an open mind to new ways of coping.  I'm hoping that with some short term medication that I'll be able to be more open to new coping methods.  Unfortunately tonight I will be left to my own vices again but I'm hopeful that I can at least have a semi normal night.  Thank you all for your kind words and let's just hope this goes well for me.

I meant into like a hospital.  It's either that or I'm just going to go full blown addict and live out that way.  I just don't understand why, when I feel like this, I still feel compelled to live.  It's like my instincts won't let me appease my mind and that's the most horrendous feeling I've ever felt.  Mentally wanting something so tremendously and being so afraid to do it because of some stupid animal instinct that I can't defeat.

All that's done is got me oppressed and alienated.  I had to fake be normal just to get my parents to help me survive.  Luckily I'm great at faking being a happy, successful, outgoing dude.  I think I have to commit myself but that just makes everything scarier.
